_about: Papiamento (Aruba). Draft: Victor checks every line before it goes live. Edit the right-hand side only. The left side is the English the site shows; {words} in braces must stay.
E receta no tin alergeno principal.
Alergia? Skirbi un nota ora bo manda bo orden.
A copi'é. Pega e den WhatsApp.
One more step: press Send in WhatsApp: Un paso mas: primi Manda den WhatsApp
Your order is typed out in the chat. Onc: Bo orden ta skirbi caba den e chat. Ora bo primi Manda, nos ta contesta riba WhatsApp pa confirm'e.
Order now for later and we confirm when: Ordena awor pa despues y nos ta confirma ora nos habri.
Caba pa awe. Por fabor kit'e.
Caya y number di cas, of un punto di referencia. E color di cas ta yuda e chauffeur.
Pone un adres pa e chauffeur.
Name: Nomber
Opens WhatsApp with your order typed out: Ta habri WhatsApp cu bo orden skirbi caba. Primi Manda einan.
Remove the sold-out dish first: Kita e cuminda cu a caba prome
Long order: it’s copied. Paste it in the: Orden largo: e ta copia. Pega e den e chat.
Tap “Copy the order instead” and paste i: Primi “Copia e orden” y pega e den WhatsApp.
In {app}? If WhatsApp doesn’t open, tap: Den {app}? Si WhatsApp no ta habri, primi ••• → Open in browser.
Use ••• then Open in browser: Usa ••• y despues Open in browser
Ta habri pronto. Bo por ordena dentro di poco.
Nos no ta tuma orden awor.
Your last order is in the bag: Bo ultimo orden ta den bo tas
The menu didn’t load. Check your connect: E menu no a carga. Controla bo conexion y carga e pagina atrobe.
Outside our usual area. We’ll confirm on: Pafo di nos area normal. Nos ta confirma riba WhatsApp si nos por yega na bo, y e costo.
WhatsApp opens with your order already w: WhatsApp ta habri cu bo orden caba skirbi. Djis primi manda.
Entrega ta tuma mas o menos {eta}.
Pregunta? Manda nos un WhatsApp na {number}.
We take cash in florins or US dollars, o: Nos ta aceptá cash den florin of dollar merikano, of un transferencia di banco.
We only deliver: there’s no pickup or di: Nos ta entrega so: no por bin buska ni sinta come.
Nothing matches “{q}”. Try one of these:: Nada no a sali pa “{q}”. Purba un di esakinan:
Each restaurant is its own order. Tap +: Cada restaurant ta su mes orden. Primi + riba loke bo ke.
E ta bai na {app} riba WhatsApp, {number}.
Cuminda tardi anochi, te na bo porta.
Bo ta paga entrega di {fee} un biaha so.
Pidi di varios restaurant na mes momento.
From one restaurant or several, in one o: Di un restaurant of di varios, den un orden.
Delivery is {fee} per order, even with d: Entrega ta {fee} pa orden, aunke bo pidi di varios restaurant.
Same order, still one {fee} delivery: Mes orden, ainda un entrega di {fee}
Tap + to add a dish, or open it for choi: Primi + pa agrega un cuminda, of habri e pa scoge cosnan manera sin cebolla.
Add dishes from any of them to the same: Agrega cuminda di cualkier di nan na mes orden: ainda un entrega di {fee}.
A dish in your order is no longer on the: Un plato di bo orden no ta riba e menu mas, p'esey nos a kit'e.
{n} is the most for one dish: {n} ta e máximo pa un plato
Your order is typed out in the chat. Onc: Bo orden ta caba skirbi den e chat. Ora bo primi Manda, nos ta confirm'e riba WhatsApp ora nos habri.
Not taking orders right now. Please remo: No ta tuma orden awor. Por fabor kit'e.
We send the bank details on WhatsApp whe: Nos ta manda e detayenan di banco riba WhatsApp ora nos confirma bo orden.
Remove the dishes we can’t take right no: Kita prome e platonan cu nos no por tuma awor
We just stopped taking orders for now. C: Nos a stop di tuma orden pa awor. Wak e ora y manda atrobe.
We’re open now. Check the time and send: Nos ta habri awor. Wak e ora y manda atrobe.
That time has passed. Pick a new time an: E ora ei a pasa caba. Scoge un ora nobo y manda atrobe.
